notes.title: Patch #2 Now Live!
notes.content:
After about a week from the last patch, we've been able to fix some things we missed before.

This patch includes the following fixes:

- Added in separate audio adjustment sliders
- Fixed name/title mistakes in the credits
- Added a "close" button on the minigames
- Fixed t-shirt cannon firing the wrong shirts
- Fixed character sprite in a conversation with Kurt
- Fixed overlapping of audience sprites

We will keep an eye out for more changes that need to be made over the next few weeks. Rock out like the superstar you are!

notes.title: Patch #1 Out Now!
notes.content:
We hope everyone has been enjoying the game and getting in 'tune' with their inner band management rockstar!

This patch includes the following fixes:
- Added live performance recordings of all tracks to the game
- Added end credits scene
- Added additional exit from the shop 
- Added missing SFX
- Items in the shop equip on purchase
- Fixed lighting errors
- Fixed issue that caused certain achievements to not unlock

We're planning on releasing more patches in the upcoming weeks. Rock On!

notes.title: Rockin' Racket Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Rockstar Managers!

We are thrilled to announce the launch of the demo for our upcoming narrative-driven band management simulator, Rockin' Racket.

Play as Harvey, a burnt-out raccoon stage manager for your younger siblings’ newly formed pop-punk band. Manage their angst-ridden shows, catch the attention of your audience, and help your siblings succeed in the biggest, loudest venues.

In the Rockin Racket demo you'll have the opportunity to meet the band members and guide them through their first concert.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2767790/Rockin_Racket/]Download the Demo Here![/url]

We're eager to hear your feedback and insights as you dive into the demo. Be on the lookout for more announcements in the coming weeks as we work towards a May release!

Rock on!

Pop Punk Paws Productions
